test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, C is written as 24 and O is written as 12. How will COLONY be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'C' is written as '24',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/022b47e2d26b93095f65972bc9b24ea526c626ede3cf51a56d90481c39009f39.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15f44f3adc93389e6d7e84d0081731d96ab5db4b5225cd58172b1779cfa20e3c.png] 

'O' is written as '12',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4084b0a2655d59103cda2068c6196aba9a62097d784ff5bde4fdc48b4a2d7bdb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/471c154d6c5fe04f304febcccee3b637b87fd883addd42b4c6a7da7a8e5b971d.png] 

Similarly, for '**COLONY**' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87b6c28716b02454c6daa431b3fe9a73d688cccf204686dfe9d3d2ad64c255b0.png] 

So, 'COLONY' will be written as '**24121512132**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
